//: Type checking of the browser UI: Browse (browse/), the apps (apps/), the shared UI helpers
(assets/ui/), by JSDoc and checkJs. Nothing is emitted; the browser runs the same .js files.
`npm run check:types:ui` runs it, and it is a step of `npm run check`.
The `include` list is an allowlist that only grows: tests/unit/ui-types.test.mjs fails when
a browser script in these folders is in neither `include` nor UI_TYPES_PENDING there.
